BiblicalUsage: Yâmash means to touch, to feel with the hand. Samson, blinded and bound, asked the lad to let him feel the pillars the house stood on, that he might lean upon them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a blinded man can find the pillars, and God gave Samson his strength back in the dark.
